speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Not surprising . Penny 's emotional responses originate from the primitive portion of the brain known as the Amygdala , while speech is centered in the much more recently developed Neocortex . The former can easily overpower the latter giving scientific credence to the notion of being rendered speechless .
